# GEO report: quay-store **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 40/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 12 ÷ 25 × 100 = 48, then capped at 40. High = (12 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 48, capped at 40. The cap applies because `static/robots.txt` blocks Googlebot from the whole site, and nothing in the project says that's intended. The uncapped score is 48. Nothing is unknown, so this is the full picture from code. All results are read from code, not measured on a live site. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking Googlebot - **Why it matters:** Googlebot is Google's search crawler. A `Disallow: /` tells it to read nothing on the site. I assumed you want to be found, because there's no `geo.config.json` stating a policy. - **Where:** `static/robots.txt:4-5` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: Googlebot` / `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small (delete the group) - **Score after this:** 72/100. Rules GEO-009 and GEO-014 become Clear (+6 points), and the cap lifts. ### 2. Make the pages render on the server - **Why it matters:** `ssr = false` turns the site into an empty page that fills in with JavaScript. Crawlers and AI tools that don't run scripts see no heading, text or links. - **Where:** `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` - **What the code says:** `export const ssr = false;` - **Size:** Small (remove the line, or enable `prerender`) - **Score after this:** 40/100 on its own, because the Googlebot cap still applies (the uncapped score would be 60). With item 1 as well: 84/100. ### 3. Set the page language and fill in descriptions - **Why it matters:** Without `lang`, tools have to guess the page language. The empty description on `/shop` gives search results nothing to show. - **Where:** `src/app.html:2` and `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` - **What the code says:** `` and `` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 40/100 on its own, because of the cap (the uncapped score would be 56). With items 1 and 2 as well: 92/100. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and reachable | Clear | `static/robots.txt` is plain text with valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access you want | Problem | `static/robots.txt:4-5` blocks Googlebot site-wide. Training crawlers aren't blocked. | | GEO-014 | Linked and sitemap routes are indexable | Problem | `/` and `/shop` are blocked from Googlebot (0 of 2 routes). `/search` is a deliberate noindex and isn't in the sitemap. | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on the site's domain | Clear | `src/routes/+page.svelte:4`, `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:4` | | GEO-003 | Main content is in server HTML | Problem | `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` (`ssr = false`, no prerender found, so every route is affected) | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid and complete | Problem | `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`. The `Product` has only `name` and no `offers`, `review` or `aggregateRating`. | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and is declared | Clear | `static/sitemap.xml` is valid and `robots.txt:7` has an absolute `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description and html lang | Problem | `src/app.html:2` has no `lang`, which affects every route. `/shop` has an empty description at line 3. | | GEO-016 | Key routes reached by real links | Clear | `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5` uses `` for Home and Shop | | GEO-017 | Snippet limits don't conflict with AI search | Clear | Only a scoped `data-nosnippet` at `+layout.svelte:7`, which is fine | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | Read the layout and 3 pages: no images, links have text, titles are present | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt | Not scored | Not present | | GEO-102 | App structured data | Not scored | Not an app | ## Other problems found - **Placeholder domain:** `quay.example` in `static/robots.txt:7`, `static/sitemap.xml:3-4` and the canonicals. Replace it with your real domain before launch, or every canonical and sitemap URL points nowhere real. - **Weak Product data:** the `Product` markup on `/shop` describes a single "Bilge pump" on a page that lists several parts (`+page.svelte:5` vs line 9). Either describe the real products with prices or remove it. ## Worth considering - **Add `lang` and viewport:** `src/app.html:2-5`: `` and ``. Add `lang="en"` (or `en-GB`) and ``. - **Give products their own pages:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:9`: `Bilge pumps, cleats and rope.` A list of categories could each have an address, such as `/shop/bilge-pumps`, with price and stock as text. - **Back up the delivery claim:** `src/routes/+page.svelte:7`: `Marine parts, shipped next day`. Say on the page what "next day" covers (cut-off time, regions), since visitors will ask. - **Move delivery info into the page body:** `src/routes/+layout.svelte:7`: `
Free delivery over £50.
`. The `data-nosnippet` looks deliberate, but if you want that fact quoted, it needs to appear in a normal page section. - **Say who the site is:** `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5` has only "Home" and "Shop". Organization structured data with your name, address and contact would label the site's identity. - **Make the page titles more descriptive:** `src/routes/search/+page.svelte:2` (`Search`) and `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:2` (`Shop all parts`). Adding the brand, for example "Shop all parts | Quay", helps people and tools see whose page it is. - **Add `` to the sitemap:** `static/sitemap.xml:3`: `https://quay.example/`. Add real update dates, or generate the sitemap from routes. - **Add a `
` landmark and a page description on `/search`:** `src/routes/+layout.svelte:6`: `{@render children()}`. Wrapping the page content in `
` makes the page structure clearer. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Suggest `geopilot logs `, which checks real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live-only checks:** real status codes, redirects, `X-Robots-Tag` headers and the raw-versus-rendered text ratio need a live scan with your URL. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI tools to find this site, because there's no `geo.config.json` stating a policy. - `quay.example` is your intended domain, taken from the canonicals, sitemap and `robots.txt`. - I read all 8 source files: 3 routes, the layout, `app.html`, `robots.txt`, the sitemap and `package.json`. The only JSON-LD source is the one on `/shop`. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
